text:
maya: Quick heads-up — PR #16230 needs to land before the Thu maintenance freeze (schema migration). CI is flaky and stuck in queue, any chance we can get a prioritized rerun/slot? :pray:
sam: I can try to trigger reruns, but there's a rebase required (conflict in migrations). I'll take the rebase if someone can eyeball the migration logic.
leo: I can review the migration today. Which env are we targeting for canary? staging or a dedicated canary pool?
maya: staging canary is fine. goal is to land before 18:00 UTC Thu to avoid the blackout.
ava: FYI load on mac-matrix is spiking; recommend avoiding heavy mac matrix reruns during office hours.
ci-bot: Rerun queued: PR #16230 — pipelines: unit, integration, e2e. Position in queue: 7. ETA ~40m.
sam: Ok doing rebase now: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main` then resolving the single migration conflict. Will push + force.
leo: ping me when pushed, I'll do a quick migration sanity check (look for data type change that caused the conflict).
ops: If it looks risky we can land behind a feature flag and roll out to 10% canary first. Also can reserve a dedicated short rebase window at 17:15 UTC if needed.
sam: pushed the rebase and forced. CI started for unit/integration. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/16230
maya: thanks — leaving a note on the PR about canary rollout plan and rollback steps.
leo: tests failing on `tests/db/migration_test.py::test_backward_compat` — looks like a nullable constraint. I can prepare a patch now, should be a one-liner.
sam: pushed fix for migration test. CI retriggered for failed jobs only.
ci-bot: Jobs retriggered, position in queue: 2. Expected completion ~15m.
ava: thumbs up on rollout plan. I'll monitor canary traffic and add a quick health-check alert. :+1:
maya: if CI passes and you folks approve, I'll request merge right away. We should avoid the maintenance blackout by ~45m cushion.
leo: approved — looks good from a schema perspective.
sam: approved from infra side.
ci-bot: All required checks passed. Merge queue: waiting for merge window permission.
ops: Granting manual merge permission for this PR; mark as `merge-before-freeze`. Please include rollback notes in the merge commit.
maya: merging now. Thanks team! :party_parrot:
ci-bot: Merge complete. Deployed canary to staging (10%). Monitoring window started.
ava: monitoring - no error spikes so far (5m). continuing watch.
maya: closing loop — if everything stable at +30m, we'll promote and schedule prod migration outside blackout. Great coordination, thanks everyone.
